query: Consider Employer's Non-Disclosure Agreement; Does the document specify whether the Receiving Party is required to destroy or return Confidential Information upon the termination of the Agreement?
gold: All such information in tangible form shall be returned to Disclosing Party promptly upon written request by Disclosing Party or the termination or expiration of this Agreement, whichever occurs first, and shall not thereafter be retained in any form by Recipient.
rag_answer: Yes. Section 4 (“Return of Information”) specifies that upon termination or expiration of the Agreement—or upon written request by the Disclosing Party, whichever occurs first—the Recipient must promptly return all Confidential Information in tangible form and may not retain it in any form. In lieu of return, the Recipient may destroy the Confidential Information, provided the destruction is certified in writing to the Disclosing Party by a duly authorized officer of the Recipient.
